Release notes

What changed.

Data snapshots and interface improvements are recorded separately.

  1. 4 Nov 2026
    Interface update

    Results explorer refined

    Ranked comparisons, success distributions and searchable task heatmaps make the existing manuscript results easier to inspect. This is a presentation update, not a new evaluation run.

  2. 15 Oct 2026
    Data snapshot

    Manuscript result snapshot recorded

    The website source recorded the six-method baseline tables for stage execution, cross-scene generalization and full-task completion. This date identifies the source import, not the experiment dates.

Method reference

The methods behind the numbers.

Open a profile for the original research and the DexArena adaptation. Reference links are not claims that upstream authors submitted or verified these scores.

PPODemo-guided RL

Proximal Policy Optimization updates an on-policy controller with a clipped policy-gradient objective.

Stage success
27.9%
Cross-scene success
21.7 ± 3.5%
Sequence success
0.0%
Original paper ↗Upstream code ↗

DexArena adds behavior-cloning warm-up and loss, demonstration-state resets, and demonstration-derived action statistics. These scores are not an evaluation of an unmodified upstream PPO implementation.

RLPDDemo-guided RL

Reinforcement Learning with Prior Data combines offline demonstrations with online interaction for policy learning.

Stage success
54.3%
Cross-scene success
17.8 ± 10.9%
Sequence success
0.0%
Original paper ↗Upstream code ↗

The DexArena baseline mixes equal numbers of demonstration and online-replay samples in each training batch. The upstream repository is a method reference, not the released DexArena evaluation checkpoint.

ACTImitation learning

Action Chunking with Transformers learns to predict sequences of robot actions from demonstrations.

Stage success
58.0%
Cross-scene success
45.4 ± 3.6%
Sequence success
1.2%
Original paper ↗Project ↗Upstream code ↗

DexArena extends the state and action spaces to arm and hand joints, weights their reconstruction losses separately, and uses multi-view temporal observations.

Diffusion PolicyImitation learning

A visually conditioned diffusion policy generates action sequences for closed-loop robot control.

Stage success
39.2%
Cross-scene success
17.2 ± 5.7%
Sequence success
0.0%
Original paper ↗Project ↗Upstream code ↗

The DexArena adaptation jointly predicts absolute arm and hand joint targets, conditioned on robot joint positions and a short image history. Upstream results use different task settings.

GR00TVLA

A vision-language-action foundation model for generalist humanoid robot control.

Stage success
61.4%
Cross-scene success
41.7 ± 14.2%
Sequence success
0.0%
Original paper ↗Upstream code ↗

DexArena adds embodiment-specific arm and hand mappings and fine-tunes the model. The manuscript cites GR00T N1; the score snapshot does not specify an exact checkpoint revision. The upstream repository may describe newer releases.

π0.5VLA

A vision-language-action model developed with heterogeneous co-training for open-world generalization.

Stage success
52.1%
Cross-scene success
49.2 ± 2.3%
Sequence success
1.6%
Original paper ↗Project ↗Upstream code ↗

The reported scores belong to the DexArena baseline, not the original model paper. The score snapshot does not specify an exact checkpoint revision or include per-run artifacts.
